import urllib.request, re, os
base='http://localhost:35535'
pages=['home.html','pg2_about.html','pg2_academics.html','pg2_athletics.html','pg2_giving.html','pg2_health-medicine.html','pg2_initiatives.html','pg2_life-at-michigan.html','pg2_research.html','pg_schools-colleges.html','pg_prospective-students.html','pg_current-students.html','pg_faculty-staff.html','pg_parents.html','pg_alumni.html','pg_about_privacy.html','pg_contact.html']
imgs=set()
for p in pages:
    try: h=open(p).read()
    except: continue
    for m in re.findall(r'(?:src|href)="(/_images/[^"]+)"', h):

os.makedirs('/workspace/recreation/public/images',exist_ok=True)
for i in sorted(imgs):
    fn='/workspace/recreation/public'+i
    try:
        urllib.request.urlretrieve(base+i, fn)
    except Exception as e:
        print('ERR',i,e)
print('done')
EOF
